title: Appwrite Helm chart values
description: Values for the Appwrite Helm chart.

targetCPUUtilizationPercentage.description: Target average CPU utilisation, in percent.

targetMemoryUtilizationPercentage.description: Target average memory utilisation, in percent. Empty disables the metric.

containerSecurityContext.description: Container security context, merged key by key over `containerSecurityContext`.

cpuNum.description: CPUs Appwrite sizes its worker and connection pools for (`_APP_CPU_NUM`). Derived from the CPU limit, then the CPU request, when empty.

extraEnv.description: Extra environment variables for this component.

extraVolumeMounts.description: Extra volume mounts for the main container.

failureThreshold.description: Consecutive failures before the probe counts as failed.

timeoutSeconds.description: Seconds before a probe times out.

enabled.description: Create a PodDisruptionBudget when more than one replica can run.

minAvailable.description: Minimum available pods. Takes precedence over `maxUnavailable`.

podSecurityContext.description: Pod security context, merged key by key over `podSecurityContext`.

preStopSleepSeconds.description: Seconds to sleep before shutdown so endpoints are removed first.

failureThreshold.description: Consecutive failures before the probe counts as failed.

successThreshold.description: Consecutive successes before the probe counts as passed again.

timeoutSeconds.description: Seconds before a probe times out.

replicaCount.description: Number of API replicas. Ignored when autoscaling is enabled.

enabled.description: Enable the startup probe. The first start creates database schemas and can take minutes.

failureThreshold.description: Consecutive failures before the probe counts as failed.

initialDelaySeconds.description: Seconds to wait before the first probe.

timeoutSeconds.description: Seconds before a probe times out.

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: Seconds to wait for in-flight requests on shutdown. Swoole drains for up to 30s.

autoCertificates.description: Have Appwrite issue Let's Encrypt certificates for function and site subdomains (`_APP_ROUTER_AUTO_CERTIFICATES`). Off by default: TLS for wildcard domains is expected to terminate at the ingress or Gateway.

certificatesEmail.description: Email used to register Let's Encrypt certificates (`_APP_EMAIL_CERTIFICATES`). Required.

config.description: Extra `_APP_*` environment variables for every Appwrite pod. They override the chart's defaults and computed values, including those set per container (`_APP_CPU_NUM`, `_APP_WORKERS_NUM`, `_APP_WORKER_MAX_COROUTINES`, `_APP_CONNECTIONS_DB_*`), except credentials, which come from Secrets. See https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/self-hosting/configuration/environment-variables.

whitelistEmails.description: Emails allowed to sign up to the console (`_APP_CONSOLE_WHITELIST_EMAILS`).

whitelistIPs.description: IPs allowed to sign up to the console (`_APP_CONSOLE_WHITELIST_IPS`).

whitelistRoot.description: Only the first user can sign up to the console; everyone else needs an invite (`_APP_CONSOLE_WHITELIST_ROOT`).

consoleDomain.description: Hostname of the console (`_APP_CONSOLE_DOMAIN`). Defaults to `domain`.

connectionsMax.description: Total connections Appwrite may open to the database, shared by all pods (`_APP_CONNECTIONS_MAX`). Keep it below the database's `max_connections`.

poolClients.description: Number of Appwrite processes sharing `connectionsMax` (`_APP_POOL_CLIENTS`): each pod opens `connectionsMax / poolClients` connections. Must be at least the number of Appwrite pods, counting autoscalers at `maxReplicas`; NOTES warns when it isn't.

database.description: Database name. Empty uses the main database name.

enabled.description: Enable DocumentsDB databases (`_APP_DOCUMENTSDB`), backed by a MongoDB replica set.

password.description: Password. Ignored when `existingSecret` is set. Empty uses the main database password.

passwordKey.description: Key in the Secret holding the password.

username.description: User. Empty uses the main database user.

domain.description: Hostname of the Appwrite API and console (`_APP_DOMAIN`). Required.

a.description: IPv4 addresses custom domains may point an A record to, comma-separated (`_APP_DOMAIN_TARGET_A`).

aaaa.description: IPv6 addresses custom domains may point an AAAA record to, comma-separated (`_APP_DOMAIN_TARGET_AAAA`).

caa.description: CAA record value custom domains must allow (`_APP_DOMAIN_TARGET_CAA`).

cname.description: Hostname custom domains must CNAME to (`_APP_DOMAIN_TARGET_CNAME`). Defaults to `domain`.

extraEnv.description: Extra environment variables for every Appwrite container, as a list of EnvVar objects.

extraEnvFrom.description: Extra `envFrom` sources for every Appwrite container.

forceHttps.description: Redirect HTTP to HTTPS and generate HTTPS URLs (`_APP_OPTIONS_FORCE_HTTPS` and `_APP_OPTIONS_ROUTER_FORCE_HTTPS`). Turn it off only when TLS isn't terminated in front of Appwrite.

functionsDomain.description: Parent domain for function preview URLs (`_APP_DOMAIN_FUNCTIONS`). Defaults to `functions.<domain>`.

routerProtection.description: Reject requests for hostnames Appwrite doesn't know (`_APP_OPTIONS_ROUTER_PROTECTION`).

secretConfig.description: Extra sensitive `_APP_*` environment variables, stored in a Secret. Same precedence as `config`; changing them restarts Appwrite pods.

allowKeyRotation.description: Allow `opensslKey` to differ from the key already stored in the cluster. Appwrite can't re-encrypt data, so changing the key makes encrypted data unreadable.

existingSecret.description: Existing Secret holding the core secrets. When empty the chart generates them once and keeps them across upgrades and uninstalls.

generate.description: Generate missing credentials (core secrets and built-in datastore passwords). Set to false with GitOps tools that render templates without cluster access (Argo CD, `helm template`), where generated values would change on every render.

geoSecret.description: Key holding `_APP_GEO_SECRET`, shared with the geo service.

opensslKey.description: Key holding `_APP_OPENSSL_KEY_V1`, which encrypts data at rest and signs JWTs.
Explicit `_APP_OPENSSL_KEY_V1`, e.g. when migrating from Docker. Never change it after install.

sitesDomain.description: Parent domain for site preview URLs (`_APP_DOMAIN_SITES`). Defaults to `sites.<domain>`.

existingSecret.description: Existing Secret holding the SMTP password.

password.description: SMTP password (`_APP_SMTP_PASSWORD`). Ignored when `existingSecret` is set.

passwordKey.description: Key in `existingSecret` holding the SMTP password.

device.description: Where Appwrite stores files (`_APP_STORAGE_DEVICE`): `local` uses the `/storage` volume (see `persistence`), `s3` any S3-compatible object store. S3 is required when `compute.enabled` is true.

previewLimit.description: Maximum size in bytes of files Appwrite renders previews for (`_APP_STORAGE_PREVIEW_LIMIT`).

accessKey.description: Access key ID. Ignored when `existingSecret` is set.

accessKeyKey.description: Key in `existingSecret` holding the access key ID.

endpoint.description: Endpoint of an S3-compatible store, e.g. `https://fsn1.your-objectstorage.com`. Empty uses AWS S3.

existingSecret.description: Existing Secret holding the access key ID and secret access key.

secretKey.description: Secret access key. Ignored when `existingSecret` is set.

secretKeyKey.description: Key in `existingSecret` holding the secret access key.

emailAddress.description: Sender address for emails Appwrite sends (`_APP_SYSTEM_EMAIL_ADDRESS`).

emailName.description: Sender name for emails Appwrite sends (`_APP_SYSTEM_EMAIL_NAME`).

securityEmailAddress.description: Address shown to users for security issues (`_APP_EMAIL_SECURITY`).

database.description: Database name. Empty uses the main database name.

enabled.description: Enable VectorsDB databases (`_APP_VECTORSDB`), backed by PostgreSQL with pgvector.

host.description: PostgreSQL hostname. Empty uses the main database, which must then be PostgreSQL.

password.description: Password. Ignored when `existingSecret` is set. Empty uses the main database password.

passwordKey.description: Key in the Secret holding the password.

username.description: User. Empty uses the main database user.

workerPerCore.description: Swoole workers per CPU in the API (`_APP_WORKER_PER_CORE`).

existingSecret.description: Existing Secret holding the OpenAI API key.

openaiApiKey.description: OpenAI API key (`_APP_ASSISTANT_OPENAI_API_KEY`). Ignored when `existingSecret` is set.

secretKey.description: Key in the Secret holding the OpenAI API key.

existingSecret.description: Existing Secret holding the password. The same URL-safety rule applies.

password.description: Password. Generated and kept across upgrades when empty. Must be URL-safe, or URL-encoded, because Appwrite reads it from a connection URL.

passwordKey.description: Key in the Secret holding the password.

storageClass.description: Storage class. Empty uses `global.storageClass`, then the cluster default; `-` requests no class.

podSecurityContext.description: Pod security context. The image's `clickhouse` user is UID 101.

commonAnnotations.description: Annotations added to every resource rendered by the chart.

commonLabels.description: Labels added to every resource rendered by the chart.

appwriteEndpoint.description: URL build Jobs use to download sources from and report back to Appwrite (`_APP_JOBS_ENDPOINT`). Defaults to the API Service in the cluster, or, with an external orchestrator, to `https://<domain>` (`http` when `forceHttps` is off), whose host must then be `appwrite.domain`.

cpuOvercommit.description: Divides each build's CPU limit to get its CPU request (`KUBE_CPU_OVERCOMMIT`). Appwrite gives builds up to 8 CPUs; the default requests 1.

createNamespace.description: Create the namespace, labelled for the `baseline` Pod Security Standard. Set to false to create it yourself.

memoryOvercommit.description: Divides each build's memory limit to get its memory request (`KUBE_MEMORY_OVERCOMMIT`). Appwrite gives builds up to 8 GiB; the default requests 1 GiB.

namespace.description: Namespace for build Jobs. Defaults to `<release namespace>-builds`. Use a different one per release when several releases share a namespace.

deniedCIDRs.description: CIDRs build pods may not reach, on top of the private, link-local, CGNAT and special-purpose ranges always blocked. Add pod, Service and node ranges that aren't private addresses (GKE privately used public ranges, IPv6 clusters).

enabled.description: Restrict build pods' traffic: no incoming connections; outgoing only to DNS, the API, the orchestrator, the S3 endpoint and public addresses. Takes effect only with a CNI that enforces NetworkPolicies.

extraEgress.description: Extra egress rules (NetworkPolicyEgressRule) for build pods, e.g. an S3 endpoint on a private network that isn't an IP address, or a private package registry.

retention.description: How long finished build Jobs are kept (`JOB_RETENTION`).

repository.description: Image repository of the sidecar that moves sources, outputs and caches for each build.

enabled.description: Enable Functions and Sites. Needs `appwrite.storage.device: s3`, and with the in-cluster executor `compute.executor.privileged` (see docs/executor.md).

createNamespace.description: Create the namespace, labelled for the `privileged` Pod Security Standard. Set to false to create it yourself.

addressPool.description: Addresses of the Docker daemon's networks, split into /24s: its bridge and the runtimes' network. They shadow anything the executor and runtimes would reach in the same range, so it must not overlap the S3 endpoint, the cluster or your networks. Docker's own default, 172.17.0.0/16 onwards, often does; this one is reserved for benchmarking (RFC 2544) and routed nowhere.

repository.description: Image repository of the Docker daemon, also used to start the executor.

volume.description: Volume for the Docker daemon's images and containers. Runtime images are pulled again when the pod is replaced.

existingSecret.description: Secret in the executor namespace with the keys `executor-secret`, `s3-access-key` and `s3-secret-key`. Pods can't read Secrets in other namespaces, so it's required when `compute.secrets.existingSecret` or `appwrite.storage.s3.existingSecret` is set. Otherwise the chart creates it.

extraEnv.description: Extra environment variables for the executor. Variables named `OPR_EXECUTOR_*` are passed on to it, e.g. `OPR_EXECUTOR_DOCKER_HUB_USERNAME` and `OPR_EXECUTOR_DOCKER_HUB_PASSWORD` to pull runtime images as a Docker Hub user.

host.description: URL of an external executor's API (`_APP_EXECUTOR_HOST`) when `mode` is `external`, e.g. `http://10.0.0.20:9900/v1`.

registry.description: Image registry. The executor image is pulled by the Docker daemon in the pod, not by the kubelet, so image pull secrets don't apply to it.

images.description: Runtime images to pull when the executor starts (`OPR_EXECUTOR_IMAGES`). Empty derives them from `functionsRuntimes` and `sitesRuntimes`, e.g. `node-22` becomes `openruntimes/node:v5-22`.

inactiveThreshold.description: Seconds a runtime may stay idle before it's removed (`OPR_EXECUTOR_INACTIVE_THRESHOLD`).

mode.description: Where executions run. `cluster`: the chart runs the executor on Docker-in-Docker in `compute.executor.namespace`. `external`: an executor you run on a Docker host, at `host`.

namespace.description: Namespace of the executor. Defaults to `<release namespace>-executor`. Use a different one per release when several releases share a namespace.

deniedCIDRs.description: CIDRs executor pods may not reach, on top of the private, link-local, CGNAT and special-purpose ranges always blocked.

enabled.description: Restrict executor pods' traffic: incoming only from Appwrite pods of this release; outgoing (which includes every runtime) only to DNS, the S3 endpoint and public addresses. Takes effect only with a CNI that enforces NetworkPolicies.

extraEgress.description: Extra egress rules (NetworkPolicyEgressRule) for executor pods, e.g. an S3 endpoint on a private network that isn't an IP address, or a registry mirror.

privileged.description: Run the Docker daemon as a privileged container, which makes it root on its node. Required in `cluster` mode unless `runtimeClassName` names a runtime that runs Docker without it, such as Sysbox. Give the executor nodes of its own (`nodeSelector`, `tolerations`).

replicaCount.description: Executor replicas. Each has its own Docker daemon: a runtime starts on the replica an execution reaches and stays there until it's idle.

resources.description: Resources of the Docker daemon container, which runs the executor and every runtime: size it for the executions you expect.

topologySpreadConstraints.description: Topology spread constraints. Empty spreads replicas across nodes.

functionsRuntimes.description: Function runtimes to enable (`_APP_FUNCTIONS_RUNTIMES`). Empty keeps the Docker installer's list (node-16.0, php-8.0, python-3.9, ruby-3.0).

host.description: URL of an external orchestrator's API (`_APP_JOBS_HOST`) when `mode` is `external`, e.g. `http://10.0.0.20:8080`.

repository.description: Image repository: the orchestrator's jobs service, with the Kubernetes backend.

mode.description: Where builds run. `cluster`: the chart runs the orchestrator, which starts every build as a Kubernetes Job in `compute.builds.namespace`. `external`: an orchestrator you run on a Docker host, at `host`.

podSecurityContext.description: Pod security context. The image's `nonroot` user is UID 65532.

executorSecretKey.description: Key holding the executor secret (`_APP_EXECUTOR_SECRET`, `OPR_EXECUTOR_SECRET` on the executor).

existingSecret.description: Existing Secret holding the executor and orchestrator secrets. When empty, the chart generates them; configure the executor (and an external orchestrator) with the same values.

orchestratorSecretKey.description: Key holding the orchestrator API key (`_APP_JOBS_SECRET`, the file in `API_KEY_FILE` on the orchestrator).

sitesRuntimes.description: Site runtimes to enable (`_APP_SITES_RUNTIMES`). Empty keeps Appwrite's default list. Sites build with `node-22`, so keep it in the list.

targetCPUUtilizationPercentage.description: Target average CPU utilisation, in percent.

targetMemoryUtilizationPercentage.description: Target average memory utilisation, in percent. Empty disables the metric.

env.description: Environment variables for the console, as a map.

extraEnv.description: Extra environment variables, as a list of EnvVar objects.

extraVolumeMounts.description: Extra volume mounts for the main container.

tag.description: Image tag. Pinned to the console that ships with the chart's appVersion.

failureThreshold.description: Consecutive failures before the probe counts as failed.

timeoutSeconds.description: Seconds before a probe times out.

enabled.description: Create a PodDisruptionBudget when more than one replica can run.

minAvailable.description: Minimum available pods. Takes precedence over `maxUnavailable`.

podSecurityContext.description: Pod security context. The console image's `bun` user is UID 1000.

failureThreshold.description: Consecutive failures before the probe counts as failed.

successThreshold.description: Consecutive successes before the probe counts as passed again.

timeoutSeconds.description: Seconds before a probe times out.

replicaCount.description: Number of console replicas. Ignored when autoscaling is enabled.

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: Seconds to wait for in-flight requests on shutdown.

topologySpreadConstraints.description: Topology spread constraints for every pod. The component's selector labels are filled in when `labelSelector` is omitted. Leave empty for a soft spread across nodes on scalable components.

enabled.description: Deploy the embedding service. When disabled, Appwrite's embedding features are turned off.
Keep downloaded models in a PersistentVolumeClaim.

storageClass.description: Storage class. Empty uses `global.storageClass`, then the cluster default; `-` requests no class.

password.description: Password. Ignored when `existingSecret` is set. Must be URL-safe, or URL-encoded, because Appwrite reads it from a connection URL.

passwordKey.description: Key in the Secret holding the password.
Key in the Secret holding the password.

port.description: Port. Defaults to the engine's standard port.

passwordKey.description: Key in the Secret holding the password.

username.description: ACL user (`_APP_REDIS_USER`). The MQTT server ignores it, so leave it empty when MQTT is enabled.

fullnameOverride.description: Override the fully qualified app name used in resource names.

enabled.description: Deploy the geo service. When disabled, Appwrite skips geolocation.

imagePullSecrets.description: Image pull secrets added to every pod, as a list of Secret names (or `{name: ...}` objects).

imageRegistry.description: Registry that replaces the registry of every image, e.g. a pull-through cache.

storageClass.description: Storage class for every PersistentVolumeClaim that doesn't set one. `-` means no class.

enabled.description: Route every hostname the Gateway listener accepts to the API, for custom domains.

parentRefs.description: Gateways (typically a dedicated catch-all listener) to attach the route to. Defaults to `httpRoute.parentRefs`.

hostnameHeaderMatch.description: Send requests that carry an `x-appwrite-hostname` header to the API instead of the console, as Appwrite's Traefik setup does. Uses a RegularExpression header match, which not every Gateway implements.

parentRefs.description: Gateways (and listeners) to attach to. Required when enabled.
Gateways to attach the wildcard route to. Defaults to `httpRoute.parentRefs`.

digest.description: Image digest (`sha256:...`). When set it pins the image and the tag is informational.

annotations.description: Annotations for every Ingress, e.g. a cert-manager issuer.

className.description: IngressClass to use. Empty uses the cluster default.

annotations.description: Annotations for the custom-domain Ingress, merged over `ingress.annotations`.

enabled.description: Route every other hostname to the API, for custom domains of projects, functions and sites. Creates an Ingress rule without a host.

secretName.description: Secret with the certificate. Defaults to `<fullname>-tls`.

annotations.description: Annotations for the wildcard Ingress, merged over `ingress.annotations`.

enabled.description: Route `*.<functionsDomain>` and `*.<sitesDomain>` (function and site preview URLs) to the API.

secretName.description: Secret with the wildcard certificate. Defaults to `<fullname>-wildcard-tls`.

activeDeadlineSeconds.description: Seconds the migration may run before it's stopped.

allowDowngrade.description: Allow upgrading to an older Appwrite version than the one installed. Appwrite can't migrate data backwards; restore a backup instead.

mode.description: How to run it. `hook`: a Helm post-upgrade hook, when the Appwrite version changes or the previous hook failed. `job`: a regular Job named after the version and a hash of its spec, for tools that don't run Helm hooks (Argo CD). `none`: run it yourself.

loadBalancerSourceRanges.description: Source ranges allowed through a LoadBalancer.

type.description: Service type. Use LoadBalancer to reach MQTT from outside the cluster.

nameOverride.description: Override the chart name used in resource names.

dns.description: DNS servers to allow (NetworkPolicyPeer) when egress is restricted, on port 53. DNS on another port (OpenShift: 5353) or NodeLocal DNSCache (169.254.20.10) needs a rule in `extraRules`.

enabled.description: Restrict egress to DNS, pods of this release and `extraRules`. Off by default: Appwrite calls webhooks, SMTP servers, OAuth providers, S3, an external executor, and the DNS server it verifies custom domains against (`_APP_DNS`, 8.8.8.8). With compute, the orchestrator also needs the Kubernetes API. Allow what you use in `extraRules`; the in-cluster executor is allowed already.

extraRules.description: Extra egress rules (NetworkPolicyEgressRule) when egress is restricted.

enabled.description: Create NetworkPolicies. They only take effect with a CNI that enforces them.

from.description: Sources (NetworkPolicyPeer) allowed to reach the API, console and realtime, typically your ingress controller or Gateway. Empty allows any source. Pods of this release can always reach them.

accessModes.description: Access modes. Use ReadWriteMany to spread API and worker pods across nodes. They mount `/storage` even with S3 storage, so a ReadWriteOnce volume pins them to one node (and the API gets no PodDisruptionBudget, which would block drains).

colocateReadWriteOnce.description: With a ReadWriteOnce volume, schedule every pod that mounts it on the same node so the volume can be attached.

enabled.description: Persist `/storage` in a PersistentVolumeClaim. When disabled every pod gets its own emptyDir, which only works with a single API and worker pod (NOTES warns otherwise).

existingClaim.description: Use an existing PersistentVolumeClaim instead of creating one.

keep.description: Keep the PersistentVolumeClaim when the release is uninstalled.

storageClass.description: Storage class. Empty uses `global.storageClass`, then the cluster default; `-` requests no class.

podSecurityContext.description: Pod security context for every pod running the Appwrite image. UID/GID 82 is `www-data`, which owns `/storage` in the image.

password.description: Password. Generated and kept across upgrades when empty.

passwordKey.description: Key in the Secret holding the password.
